what: Proposed commit-content forbidden check uses exact path intersection only
scenario_or_breakage: `post_dispatch_forbidden_revert` rejects `forbidden_path/*` but the plan awk only matches top-level diff paths; a coder commit under a submodule directory (e.g. `vendor/foo/bar`) can pass and be pushed
suggested_fix: Reuse the same prefix `case` logic as `post_dispatch_forbidden_revert` (or factor a shared helper) when scanning `git diff --name-only "$baseline_head".."$current_head"`
